skills.name: limrun-xcode
skills.description: Build an iOS / Apple app on remote Xcode with `lim xcode build` instead of local xcodebuild, run project commands with `lim xcode run`, or run its XCTest suites with `lim xcode test`, from any environment (Linux, Windows, macOS, VM, container). Use for non-Bazel projects (an `.xcodeproj` / `.xcworkspace`, an XcodeGen `project.yml` with a gitignored project, React Native / Expo native build) when the user wants to build, compile, run code generation or Make targets, test, inspect build logs, reload, produce a preview build, or ship a signed device IPA. To run, tap, screenshot, or otherwise interact with the result on a simulator, use limrun-ios-simulator. For Bazel workspaces, use limrun-xcode-bazel.

skills.name: limrun-ios-simulator
skills.description: Drive an app running on a Limrun cloud iOS simulator: launch, tap, type, read the accessibility element tree, read app logs and simulator syslog, screenshot, record video, connect the app to local services or a private tunnel, play a video file as the camera, send all traffic through the user's proxy and trust its CA, set the clipboard, read and write user defaults, post notifications, and run timed action chains. Use after a build (from any builder) when the user wants to see, test, or interact with their app on a simulator, or says 'show me a screenshot', 'tap', 'run the UI test', 'record a video', 'read the logs', 'connect localhost', 'reach my local server from the simulator', 'route all traffic through my proxy', 'trust my CA', 'mock the camera', 'paste into the app', 'change the language', 'simulate Face ID', or 'launch on simulator'. To build the app first, use limrun-xcode-bazel (Bazel workspaces) or limrun-xcode (xcodebuild projects).

skills.name: limrun-expo-development
skills.description: Prepare and run Expo / React Native apps on Limrun with Expo dev-client iteration. Use when the user wants an Expo dev build, Metro tunnel, hot reload, JS/TS iteration without repeated native rebuilds, or to run/test an Expo app on a remote iOS simulator or Android emulator.

skills.name: limrun-detox-testing
skills.description: Configure, run, or debug Detox on Limrun iOS simulators. Use when attaching the Limrun Detox runtime to an app, wiring Detox mediator connectivity, or validating app/tester connections over destination tunnels.

skills.name: limrun-maestro-testing
skills.description: Run Maestro YAML flows against a Limrun cloud iOS simulator with `lim ios maestro`, from any environment (Linux, Windows, macOS, VM, container). Use when the user wants to run, write, or debug Maestro flows or `maestro test` on iOS, migrate an existing Maestro suite to remote simulators, or asks for UI testing with Maestro. iOS simulators only today. For Detox suites use limrun-detox-testing; for driving the simulator without a test framework use limrun-ios-simulator.

skills.name: limrun-xcode-bazel
skills.description: Legacy: build a Bazel iOS app with `lim xcode rbe` on a dedicated Xcode sandbox and install it on a remote iOS simulator attached to that sandbox. Use only when the workspace already runs on `lim xcode rbe` (its `.limrun/` came from `lim xcode rbe`) or the user explicitly asks for it, or when a `lim xcode rbe` build, upload, or install misbehaves. For every other Bazel build, including new workspaces, iOS or Android, and running the app on a simulator, use limrun-bazel. To tap, type, screenshot, or otherwise interact with the running app, use limrun-ios-simulator.

skills.name: limrun-bazel
skills.description: The default way to build any Bazel workspace on Limrun: build its iOS and Android targets on Limrun's shared build plane with `lim bazel setup` and `bazel build --config=limrun`, from any environment (Linux, Windows, macOS, VM, container, CI), with one remote cache shared across the organization. Use when the project is a Bazel workspace (MODULE.bazel) with rules_apple or rules_android and the user wants to build it remotely, run the built app on a Limrun simulator or emulator, set up Bazel remote execution in CI, or fix a `--config=limrun` build that fails on authentication, workers, or missing MODULE.bazel lines. limrun-xcode-bazel covers only the legacy `lim xcode rbe` flow; use it only when the workspace already runs on `lim xcode rbe` or the user asks for it. For non-Bazel Android builds, use limrun-gradle.

skills.name: limrun-gradle
skills.description: Build an Android app on a remote Gradle sandbox with `lim gradle build` instead of local Gradle or Android Studio, from any environment (Linux, Windows, macOS, VM, container). Use when the user wants to build an APK or AAB, sign a release with an upload key, prepare a Play Store publish, inspect build logs, or select sandbox tools and run shell commands, for native Android projects, React Native, and Expo. To run, tap, screenshot, or otherwise interact with the built APK on an emulator, use limrun-android-emulator. For iOS builds, use limrun-xcode or limrun-expo-development.

skills.name: limrun-android-emulator

Use after a build (from limrun-gradle or any builder) when the user wants to see, test, or interact with their app on an emulator, or says 'show me a screenshot', 'tap', 'run it on the emulator', 'check logcat', 'record a video', 'inspect network traffic', 'route all traffic through my proxy', or 'reach my local server from the emulator'. To build the APK or AAB first, use limrun-gradle.
